wa_energizer_bunny.notes: Traverse under an arching roof base beneath the 'elephant ear' feature; dirty/burly climbing to a ledge belay.
An 'awesome' four-star corner pitch, fists-to-fingers, ending at an exposed ledge belay.
Crack becomes a vertical face (roughly 5.12- free equivalent); a short ~15 ft section is typically aided. This is the route's technical/aid crux.
The route's namesake 'bunny ears' crack — steep, fingery climbing with good locks; joins Solid Gold's pitch 4 line.
Shared finishing pitch with Solid Gold: a perfect corner crack stepping right to a tree near the ridge.
